preconditions.description: The number of planets n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of plans q must be between 1 and 100,000.
The starting planet s must be a valid planet index within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output) and len(output) == n
postconditions.description: The output must be a list of n integers representing the minimum cost to reach each planet.
